title: EFormer: Temporally Aligned Local Correction for Continuous sEMG-Based Hand Pose Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2609.38932v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG) provides a wearable, camera-free signal for continuous hand-motion inference. Mapping muscle activity to joint kinematics remains challenging because the recorded waveforms are indirect measurements, their relationship with motion changes over time, and individual anatomy and sensor placement alter the signal distribution. This paper presents EFormer, a residual feature-correction network built on a frozen tracking backbone. EFormer combines a high-rate event branch, temporally aligned local cross-attention, two causal rotary position embedding (RoPE) temporal layers, and a bounded, dynamically gated residual.   EFormer receives 16-channel sEMG sampled at 2 kHz and fuses a 64-channel tracking representation at 25 Hz with a 128-channel event representation at 200 Hz. translated_title: EFormer：面向连续sEMG手部姿态追踪的时间对齐局部校正
translated_abstract: 表面肌电信号为连续手部动作推断提供了一种可穿戴、无需摄像头的信号来源。然而，将肌肉活动映射到关节运动学仍然具有挑战性，因为记录的波形属于间接测量，其与运动之间的关系会随时间变化，且个体解剖差异和传感器佩戴位置也会改变信号分布。本文提出了EFormer，一个构建在冻结追踪主干之上的残差特征校正网络。EFormer融合了高速率事件分支、时间对齐的局部交叉注意力、两个因果旋转位置编码时间层，以及有界动态门控残差机制。EFormer接收以2 kHz采样的16通道sEMG信号，并将25 Hz的64通道追踪表示与200 Hz的128通道事件表示进行融合。交叉注意力采用100 ms的名义延迟、300 ms的历史参数和50 ms的容差；其因果掩码将每个查询限制在……
tldr: EFormer是一种构建在冻结追踪主干上的残差特征校正网络，通过时间对齐局部交叉注意力、因果RoPE时间层和动态门控残差，实现从sEMG信号到连续手部姿态的高精度追踪。
en_tdlr: EFormer is a residual feature-correction network built on a frozen tracking backbone that leverages temporally aligned local cross-attention, causal RoPE temporal layers, and a dynamically gated bounded residual to achieve accurate continuous hand pose tracking from sEMG signals.
